title: Pollo AI combines model routing with guided ad creation
friendlyTitle: Pollo AI turns rough ideas into guided video and ad workflows
summary: Pollo AI uses different OpenAI models for routing, narrative planning and image generation inside a guided workflow for videos and campaigns. The company says users spend less time choosing and switching models.
friendlySummary: Pollo AI uses different AI models for different parts of creative work, such as planning a story, making images and building a short ad.
whyItMatters: The useful pattern is orchestration, not merely generation: match cheaper models to routine steps and stronger models to harder creative decisions. Small teams can apply the same approach to control cost and reduce tool friction.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Using the right model for each step can save time and money instead of using the most powerful model for everything.
